description: Finds Indian credit cards by name, issuer, network, fee band and three filters: forex markup of 1% or under, lounge access, transfer partners. Each card comes with its slug, annual and joining fee, base earn, one line of facts, grade, check date, source and its page on getbrief.cards. Cards no longer issued are left out unless include_discontinued is true. Use a slug from here in every other call.

fee_band.description: Fee band, held against the higher of the annual and joining fee: free (Lifetime free), low (Up to ₹1,000), mid (Up to ₹5,000), high (Up to ₹15,000), top (Above ₹15,000).

forex_1pct_or_under.description: Only cards whose forex markup is 1% or under.

include_discontinued.description: Include cards no longer issued. Their rules stay on record as dated history.

issuer.description: Issuer slug, such as axis, hdfc, icici, sbi, amex. A wrong slug answers with the full list.

limit.description: At most this many cards. 10 if unset.

lounge.description: Only cards with lounge access on record.

network.description: Card network: visa, mastercard, rupay, amex, diners.

query.description: Words from the card’s name, issuer or points currency, such as "atlas", "infinia", "amex platinum".

transfers.description: Only cards whose points transfer to an airline or hotel programme.

name: search_cards
title: Search Indian credit cards
